verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Babylon.js transparently runs on WebGL 1.0, WebGL 2.0 and WebGPU. For payload, it ships as tree-shakable ES6 modules on npm, and the team points to incremental loading for scene assets. One community report notes the engine is about three times the size of three.js and needs bandwidth optimization, which tempers the 'reasonable payload' part. missing for 10: in-depth WebGPU documentation or hands-on corroboration of WebGPU maturity, concrete bundle-size measurements showing tree-shaking yields a reasonable payload.
